description: Turn auto-renew on/off for a domain you own and/or fund its renewal balance (vault). deposit_usd moves USDC from your prepaid balance (topup_balance) into the domain's vault; withdraw_usd moves it back. The daily job renews 1 year when ≤30 days from expiry if the vault covers the price, otherwise emails reminders at 30/14/7/1 days.

api_key.description: Optional. Guest or dashboard API key (sd_live_…). Prefer Authorization: Bearer <key> on the MCP connection; if your client cannot set headers, pass the key here.

name: set_auto_renew
title: Set auto-renew / fund renewal vault
